note: Handpicked diagnostic sample from the completed XiYan spike; not an unbiased benchmark.
mapping: Each database is identified by the unique BIRD SQLite database on which the stored gold SQL executes successfully; positional case ids are not used.

cases.baseline: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE element = 'n' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = atom.molecule_id AND label = '+');
cases.xiyan: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 'n' AND T1.label = '+'
cases.gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 'n' AND T1.label = '+'

cases.baseline: SELECT DISTINCT c.asciiName FROM cards c INNER JOIN sets s ON c.printings LIKE '%' || s.code || '%' WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap' ORDER BY c.convertedManaCost DESC;
cases.xiyan: SELECT T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1.setCode = T2.code WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap' ORDER BY T1.convertedManaCost DESC LIMIT 1
cases.gold: SELECT T1.name FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.convertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap')

cases.baseline: SELECT s1.weight_kg - s2.weight_kg FROM superhero s1 JOIN superhero s2 ON s1.id = s2.id AND LOWER(s1.full_name) = 'Emil Blonsky' AND LOWER(s2.full_name) = 'Charles Chandler';
cases.xiyan: SELECT ( SELECT weight_kg FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky' ) - ( SELECT weight_kg FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler' ) AS diff
cases.gold: SELECT (SELECT weight_kg FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'Emil Blonsky') - (SELECT weight_kg FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'Charles Chandler') AS CALCULATE

cases.baseline: SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 186;
cases.xiyan: SELECT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'tr186'
cases.gold: SELECT T.atom_id FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR186'

cases.baseline: SELECT Team_Attributes.chanceCreationPassing, Team_Attributes.chanceCreationPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes WHERE Team_Attributes.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe' AND Team_Attributes.chanceCreationPassing IS NOT NULL;
cases.xiyan: SELECT T1.team_short_name FROM Team AS T1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE T2.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'
cases.gold: SELECT DISTINCT t1.team_short_name FROM Team AS t1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'

cases.baseline: SELECT Name FROM badges WHERE UserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Sharpie');
cases.xiyan: SELECT T2.Name FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Sharpie'
cases.gold: SELECT T2.Name FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'Sharpie'
